name: troubleshoot-offertoday-cursor-contract-failures
title: Prevent isolated crawl failures from aborting recoverable work
description: Handle the verified OfferToday listing collection window and CTgoodjobs item-specific detail persistence failures without losing valid work or overstating completion.
creator: karashawy
notes: Implemented and regression-tested the OfferToday page-46 source_collection_window partial-and-continue boundary, CTgoodjobs Job/Company location ownership isolation, and deployed-column oversize classification. On 2026-08-25 the user-approved jobs.location VARCHAR(255) to TEXT cutover completed safely after backup SHA-256 2e9a96d1bf0bf1466a62a58f77d4020b1d3e244397d096aa481c6fb1f76953b2, zero-active-work checks, transactional validation, unchanged row counts, and service health recovery. Remaining scope is narrowly defined: controlled OfferToday live verification and one new CTgoodjobs retry. The 95 MB local database backup is operational evidence and must remain untracked, not a Git artifact.
